about_the_game:
Explore desert crypts and underwater palaces with the Rogue Adventure - Wonders Tileset! ELV Games is back with another addition to their Rogue Adventure series, this time with tiles to help your heroes sail the seven seas and visit even more dungeons! 1 A1, 2 A2, 1 A3, 1 A4, 2 A5, and 19 B sheets cover pyramids, underwater temples, and ship exteriors so your heroes can explore the world and help stop the demon lord!

Each tile is sized for Ace and MV/MZ, so you can easily add them to your favorite engine. Pick up the Rogue Adventure - Wonders Tileset and let your heroes travel across oceans and plunge deep into the sea to find even more loot!


Wonders Pack contains Atlantis tilesets, Pyramid tilesets and a Ship tileset!

Atlantis Content:

・Atlantis tiles for your game
・Multiple type of walls, ground, cliffs, holes, objects and more
・Animated grass, tombstones, glyphs and chest


Pyramid Content:

・Pyramid
・Color variation (dark/light)
・ground and wall tiles
・Interior tiles included
・Various urns, coffins, boxes, pillars etc.
・Animated torches, doors and glyphs


Ship Content:

・Ship tiles for your game
・Ship Interior tiles included
・Treasure chests, tables&chairs, bookshelf, barrel etc.
・Walls, doors and stairs
・Lots of props to create your Ship Interior



Terms of Use:

* This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
* OK to be used in Commercial projects
* Contents can be edited
* OK for use in games with gore
* OK for use in adult-rated games
